title: Fernando Botero's birth chart
metaDescription: Fernando Botero's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 29.4° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Aries — the Sun, Mercury, Mars and Uranus. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 29.4° Aries. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the classical scheme — a fire sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Aries (14.5°), Venus in Gemini (15.0°), Mars in Aries (12.7°): a mind that decides at speaking speed, taste led by wit and proportion, drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Uranus and Pluto hold the closest angle here — a square, 0.1° wide. Nothing in a square flows; everything in it works. The old texts kept squares for the charts they respected. Behind it, Mars trine Jupiter at 0.1°, and Mercury sextile Venus at 0.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has three entries for this chart. The Sun in Aries at 29.4° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Mars in Aries at 12.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Aquarius at 4.3° is in domicile. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 5 fire, 3 air, 1 earth, 1 water by element and 6 cardinal, 2 mutable, 2 fixed by mode. Mercury and Neptune were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Libra for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 15.1° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 12.5°.
